ui.shell.collapsible_app_logo.local_oper.note: Expanded wordmark beside the icon; collapsed icon accessible name.

ui.shell.panel_rail.panels.note: Names the toolbar holding the run, console, browser, canvas, code-review and asks doors.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.agent_hub.note: The public catalogue for discovering and installing agents. Destinations are proper names and take title case (Agent Hub, Team Bridge, Library); actions are sentences and take sentence case (New chat, Search). Localised labels follow their own locale's conventions rather than English title case.
ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.agent_hub.length: Single sidebar row; aim for 1–2 words.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.agents.note: The operator-owned agent roster, not the public catalogue. Destinations are proper names and take title case (Agent Hub, Team Bridge, Library); actions are sentences and take sentence case (New chat, Search). Localised labels follow their own locale's conventions rather than English title case.
ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.agents.length: Single sidebar row; aim for 1–2 words.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.aida_missed.note: Names the chief-of-staff row with unread messages; singular and plural must agree with count. The number skeleton disables grouping to preserve the original English decimal count spelling even at 1000; cardinal selection remains numeric.

placeholders.name: User-configured chief-of-staff display name, verbatim.
placeholders.count: Number of missed messages; ICU plural cardinal.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.aida_missed.plural_guidance: English one/other is source grammar, not a target-locale limit. Russian needs native few/many; Arabic needs zero/two and native few/many where appropriate. Keep count-invariant English status words unchanged while allowing native agreement.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.aida_working.note: Chief-of-staff row while a turn is running; no completion implied.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.browser.note: The integrated browser workspace. Destinations are proper names and take title case (Agent Hub, Team Bridge, Library); actions are sentences and take sentence case (New chat, Search). Localised labels follow their own locale's conventions rather than English title case.
ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.browser.length: Single sidebar row; aim for 1–2 words.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.browser_wait.note: Names browser approvals waiting for the operator. English waiting is count-invariant but both grammatical branches are intentional.

placeholders.count: Uncapped pending cardinal count for grammatical number.
placeholders.countText: Existing decimal display string, without English grouping punctuation.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.browser_wait.plural_guidance: English one/other is source grammar, not a target-locale limit. Russian needs native few/many; Arabic needs zero/two and native few/many where appropriate. Keep count-invariant English status words unchanged while allowing native agreement.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.close_sideba.note: Describes what pressing the sidebar toggle will do: dismiss the narrow-screen drawer.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.collapse_sid.note: Describes what pressing the sidebar toggle will do: reduce the desktop sidebar to icons.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.drag_armed.tone: Instruction with a cancel affordance; calm, not alarmed.
ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.drag_armed.note: Announced when a pointer drag arms on a destination row: names the row being moved and the key that aborts the gesture. Esc restores the starting layout.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.expand_sideb.note: Describes what pressing the sidebar toggle will do: restore desktop navigation labels.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.mesh.note: Linked devices and peer sessions. Destinations are proper names and take title case (Agent Hub, Team Bridge, Library); actions are sentences and take sentence case (New chat, Search). Localised labels follow their own locale's conventions rather than English title case.
ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.mesh.length: Single sidebar row; aim for 1–2 words.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.mesh_waiting.note: Names mesh requests waiting for the operator. English waiting is count-invariant but both grammatical branches are intentional.

placeholders.count: Uncapped pending cardinal count for grammatical number.
placeholders.countText: Existing decimal display string, without English grouping punctuation.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.mesh_waiting.plural_guidance: English one/other is source grammar, not a target-locale limit. Russian needs native few/many; Arabic needs zero/two and native few/many where appropriate. Keep count-invariant English status words unchanged while allowing native agreement.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.more_waiting.note: Names the More disclosure with the summed attention count of the destinations folded inside it. The count is never hidden by customisation: an unread chief of staff must stay reachable. English waiting is count-invariant but both grammatical branches are intentional.

placeholders.count: Uncapped pending cardinal count for grammatical number.
placeholders.countText: Existing decimal display string, without English grouping punctuation.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.more_waiting.plural_guidance: English one/other is source grammar, not a target-locale limit. Russian needs native few/many; Arabic needs zero/two and native few/many where appropriate. Keep count-invariant English status words unchanged while allowing native agreement.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.more_working.tone: Quiet in-progress status; no completion implied.
ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.more_working.note: Names the More disclosure while at least one folded destination is working. Mirrors the working glyph the More row carries so hidden activity is still announced.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.move_down.note: Moves the focused destination one rendered position down inside its own region. Disabled at the region's bottom boundary. Keyboard equivalent: Alt+ArrowDown.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.move_note.tone: Plain confirmation of what just changed.
ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.move_note.note: Announced after a keyboard or menu reorder, giving the new one-based position within the rendered list and the list's total. Positions are counts, not ordinals, so no locale ordinal rules apply.

placeholders.name: Destination label as displayed, verbatim.
placeholders.position: One-based position after the move; rendered as a plain number.
placeholders.total: Number of destinations currently rendered in that region.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.move_to_more.note: Folds the focused visible destination into More, appending it at the end of that region and opening the fold so the landing is visible. More is the feature's own region name and matches the row's label.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.move_to_more.tone: Plain confirmation of what just changed.
ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.move_to_more.note: Announced after a destination is moved out of the visible list into the More fold.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.move_up.note: Moves the focused destination one rendered position up inside its own region. Disabled at the region's top boundary. Keyboard equivalent: Alt+ArrowUp.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.new_chat.note: Stages an untargeted conversation draft; does not immediately send a message.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.new_chat_sho.note: Same new-chat action as the visible button, with its platform-specific chord.

placeholders.shortcut: Keyboard chord already formatted for the platform; preserve verbatim.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.projects.note: Workstreams and milestones, not filesystem folders. Destinations are proper names and take title case (Agent Hub, Team Bridge, Library); actions are sentences and take sentence case (New chat, Search). Localised labels follow their own locale's conventions rather than English title case.
ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.projects.length: Single sidebar row; aim for 1–2 words.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.reset_layout.note: Restores the sidebar's default destination order and fold. Offered only when the current layout differs from the default.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.reset_note.tone: Plain confirmation of what just changed.
ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.reset_note.note: Announced after the sidebar layout is restored to its default arrangement.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.row_actions.tone: Short label naming the row and what the control opens.
ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.row_actions.note: Accessible name of the ellipsis button on a destination row (and the right-click/Shift+F10 menu). Opens the move, change-region and reset commands.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.save_failed.tone: Direct statement of the failure and its subject; no blame, no jargon.
ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.save_failed.note: Shown when writing the sidebar layout fails. The previous arrangement has already been restored when this appears, so it says what could not be saved rather than asking for a retry.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.schedules.note: Recurring or scheduled runs. Destinations are proper names and take title case (Agent Hub, Team Bridge, Library); actions are sentences and take sentence case (New chat, Search). Localised labels follow their own locale's conventions rather than English title case.
ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.schedules.length: Single sidebar row; aim for 1–2 words.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.search.note: Opens the everything command palette; chats have a separate shortcut.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.search_acces.note: Everything palette versus conversation-only quick switcher; do not collapse the two actions into one.

placeholders.everything: Platform shortcut for the everything palette.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.search_toolt.note: Everything palette versus conversation-only quick switcher; do not collapse the two actions into one.

placeholders.everything: Platform shortcut for the everything palette.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.settings.length: Single sidebar row; aim for 1–2 words.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.show_in_side.note: Brings a destination folded inside More back into the visible sidebar list, appending it at the end of that region.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.show_in_side.tone: Plain confirmation of what just changed.
ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.show_in_side.note: Announced after a destination is moved out of the More fold into the visible list.

ui.shell.user_profile_sidebar.account_se.note: Profile-row press opens account preferences when there is no reconnect action.

ui.shell.user_profile_sidebar.account_un.note: Account read failed; do not imply the user signed out or the account was deleted.

ui.shell.user_profile_sidebar.checking_a.note: Replaces the account display name while Radient account data is unresolved; retain ellipsis.

ui.shell.user_profile_sidebar.privacy_an.note: Account dropdown privacy/security entry; this extraction does not alter its interaction.

ui.shell.user_profile_sidebar.reconnect_.role: menu action, profile-row hint and tooltip
ui.shell.user_profile_sidebar.reconnect_.note: Opens Settings with Radient preselected so the refused account connection can be repaired.

ui.shell.user_profile_sidebar.settings.note: Opens the main application Settings page from the profile dropdown.

ui.shell.user_profile_sidebar.sign_out.note: Signs out and reloads the app to clear authentication state; not a quit action.

ui.shell.user_profile_sidebar.user.note: Only the ordinary signed-out placeholder, not an account failure.
